sloka: अयं तु भावो दुर्बुद्धे यस्त्वयेह प्रवर्तितः ।मानुषेष्वपि लोकेषु भविष्यति न संशयः ।। ७.३०.३४ ॥
transliteration: ayaṁ tu bhāvo durbuddhe yastvayeha pravartitaḥ ।mānuṣeṣvapi lokeṣu bhaviṣyati na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.30.34 ॥

translations.english: But this consequence, O evil-minded one, which you have initiated here, will undoubtedly also manifest in the human worlds.
